tools.name: search_loadouts
tools.description: Search SetupBay for rule/skill/MCP bundles. Ranked by relevance to `query`; filter by agent, tags (stacks such as nextjs, godot, python) or category. With no query, lists loadouts (featured and verified first).

tools.name: get_loadout
tools.description: Metadata for one loadout: description, agent compatibility, verification and agent-test status, requirements, and the file list with roles, sizes, raw URLs and per-agent install paths.

tools.name: get_loadout_file
tools.description: Raw contents of one file in a loadout (path as listed by get_loadout, e.g. AGENTS.md or skills/db-migration/SKILL.md). Max 100 KB.

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: Exact install steps for one loadout and agent: each file's target path in the project, its raw URL, ready-to-run curl commands, manual steps (e.g. MCP servers for agents without a project config file) and the zip URL.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Supported coding agents with the instructions file each reads, its skills directory and where project MCP config goes.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: All tags (stacks) and categories in the catalogue, with loadout counts. Use them as search_loadouts filters.
